pr_body:
Drop `RowExec` physical node: `Row` is now optimised away into a `LocalRelation`, which has its own physical mapping.
`Row` is kept around as a container for the logical optimisations/folding of the expressions supported by the `ROW` command (which makes it in fact a source _plus_ `EVAL`), `LocalRelation` only being a container for the schema and end results (it doesn't actually go through transformations).

Fixes #104960

issue_context.title: ESQL: LocalSourceExec and RowExec are very similar
issue_context.body:
### Description

Both Row/RowExec and LocalRelation/LocalSourceExec have the same purpose and it's likely one can be replaced with the other and simplify the hierarchy across plans and operators.

review_comments: Do you think there is a chance we could have `Row` implement `SurrogateLogicalPlan` in a follow up? So that `Row` only exists directly after parsing and is turned into a local relation ASAP - while also making this new cleanup rule obsolete?

This is a nice idea, but the issue is that the substitutions happen too early -- all the evaluation of what can be in ROW happens only later. If ROW was a source _only_, we could have given rid of it directly after parsing. But since we allow expressions within it, we need to have `Row` go through "Operator Optimization" batch (so "EVAL" it).
I think `RowOperator` also becomes obsolete with this PR and can be removed? Maybe let's do this right away?
